title: Question Leading Suggestions
description: To resist suggestibility: - Slow down: Reflect before accepting others’ suggestions as true. - Seek evidence: Verify claims rather than relying on someone’s framing. - Ask critical questions: “Is this my thought, or has it been influenced?” Example: If someone suggests a memory (“Remember when we all agreed?”), ask for details to confirm.
